evidence.title: Meta makes AI glasses slightly less creepy with limit on nonconsensual recording

summary: Meta announced a software update for its AI‑powered smart glasses that blocks recording without the subject’s consent, aiming to ease privacy worries. The feature automatically disables the camera and emits an audible alert when the device detects potential non‑consensual capture.
title: Meta adds anti‑nonconsensual recording limits to its AI glasses
